label: task
issue
definition: One self-contained change tracked as one GitHub issue: one branch <kind>/<N>-<slug>, one worktree, one PR that says Closes #N. cckit start opens it, cckit pr opens its PR, cckit merge or cckit close ends it.
is_not: An effort: an effort decomposes into sub-issues and ships as one PR for all of them.
A light task: a light task is tracked in a file under tasks/ and has no GitHub issue.
A sub-issue: a sub-issue has no PR of its own.
